# Ai-Animation skills (third-party, MIT)

The format skills in `.claude/skills/` listed in `studio/IMPORTED_SKILLS.json` come from the owner's [Ai-Animation](https://github.com/manikk90/Ai-Animation) repo, commit `f02c89a`. Upstream, the skills are by aansh.ai ([aanshai.vercel.app/skills](https://aanshai.vercel.app/skills)), MIT licensed: see `LICENSE` here.

- Imported on 2026-11-08 at the owner's request, by `studio/import_skills.py`.
- Each copy keeps its original text and adds a studio-harness block under its title. The contract is `studio/SKILL_HARNESS.md`.
- `daksh-ai` comes with its engine, harness and tools. Its `template/assets/gsap.min.js` keeps GSAP's own licence header.
- To update, re-run `python3 studio/import_skills.py <Ai-Animation clone>`. Never edit the copies by hand.
